finding: Original full text section 3.5.2.1 identifies M14 as a GSH conjugate. The apparent abstract/figure ambiguity is not an extraction error. No resolved structure was available, so it remains unretrievable.
INF is infigratinib and its existing correctly bound DEREK prediction agrees with Table 6. It remains a predicted overall outcome in L2.
EMIM negative mechanistic results agree with the primary paper. BMIM is a different compound; over-transfer is not evidence that EMIM records are false. Primary LLNA did not reach SI3 for BMIM.

Original section on user safety confirms thiamine HCl OECD 442C low-reactivity positive and 442D/442E negative; the overall sensitization assessment also uses clinical/earlier evidence. Contradictory endpoints are not erroneous assays.

Lovastatin is a positive control for cholesterol depletion in the NiSO4 MoDC study. The reported cholesterol readout is correct, but is not a sensitization final outcome. The focal model explicitly discounted it.

Author-associated summary supports 1,4-diaminoanthraquinone identity and sensitizer status. The exact mDPRA category and 521 pg/mg IL18 table entry were not independently verified from the full original article; no confirmed error established.
No confirmed source error established. Exact original assay tables/abstract passage were not obtained in this review; negative or limited-scope results alone are not grounds for exclusion.
